summary.text: Toni Scalia is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Jesse Borjon.
Scalia also ran for the same seat in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Toni Scalia advanced from the Democratic primary for District 52 on August 4, 2026, receiving 2,370 votes in a race with no other Democratic candidate.
Scalia first sought the seat in 2018, when she won the Democratic primary and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Brenda Dietrich, 30.7 percent to 69.3 percent.
